flags.why: Khể thủ requires the forehead to touch the ground, rather than rest on crossed hands ([Buddhist dictionary](https://phatgiao.org.vn/tu-dien-phat-hoc-online/khe-thu-k35309.html)).
flags.fix: to kowtow with one's forehead touching the ground (a deeply respectful form of homage)

flags.why: The common everyday meaning of feeling carefree or having little effort to expend is missing ([linguistic study](https://scholar.dlu.edu.vn/thuvienso/bitstream/DLU123456789/168513/1/CTv75S32021026.pdf)).

This expression is mainly associated with Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([Southern Vietnamese teaching reference](https://svff.online/blog/vietnamese-sports-exercise-vocabulary-southern)).
The gloss omits that the otherwise blank document already bears a signature or stamp ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kh%E1%BB%91ng_ch%E1%BB%89)).
flags.fix: signed or stamped but otherwise blank (of a document or form)
